title: AAPS 3.2.0.4 and NSCLIENTv3 has 10 Entries in queue
symptom: The user constantly has entries in the queue from the NSCLIENTV3 tab, with 10 entries remaining after a full synchronization that counts down from around 50,000. Data appears to be uploading to Nightscout and no errors are found.
cause: AAPS tries to sync a deletion of a food entry with Nightscout, but the record with that identifier is not found, causing a java exception that leaves entries in the queue.
